note: OpenFEMA NfipPolicies v3. Pulled with propertyState eq 'PR' and policyTerminationDate gt '2026-09-08T00:00:00.000Z': 7042 policy terms of the 315431 Puerto Rico terms the dataset holds since 2009; the filter leaves out every term that ended on or before the snapshot date, so no history of past years is kept. In force on 2026-09-08 (the asOfDate FEMA stamps on the records, the latest date the data can speak for) = policyEffectiveDate on or before that date, policyTerminationDate after it, and no cancellationDateOfFloodPolicy on or before it. Pulled but not counted: 325 terms not yet effective on that date, 92 cancelled by it, 0 ended by it. Island total: 6625 policy contracts covering 10743 insured units (FEMA's policyCount: a condominium association contract insures many units), building coverage $1,886,036,000, contents coverage $162,531,000, premium $3,305,802 (totalInsurancePremiumOfThePolicy for the term; fees and surcharges not included). Municipio = first five digits of censusGeoid; this version has no county field. 7 contracts (7 units) have no usable code and are in no municipio, so municipio values are a floor. FEMA says the dataset lags the system of record, so terms that began shortly before the date may still be missing. Tracts: first eleven digits of censusGeoid, current TIGER tracts only (703 tracts; 0 contracts in tract codes that are not current). Derived from redacted records; not FEMA's official policies-in-force count, and private flood insurance is not included.
